summary: Miami Nights is a weekly Saturday-night Latin dance party thrown by Hemingway's Cuba, a rooftop bar inside the Cambria Downtown Asheville hotel: a free beginner salsa/bachata lesson from an outside dance company (Duarte Latin Dance / DuARTE), then DJ MTN Vibez spinning salsa, bachata, reggaeton and Latin house for social dancing until 1am. It reads as the venue's recurring promotional night (drink specials, bar bites, free admission) rather than a self-organized community with its own identity.

evidence.note: Explore Asheville listings across 19 weekly dates have only AI-style venue-promo summaries ('tropical late-night Latin social dancing', 'Miami-style Latin dance night'); no descriptions, membership language, or named regulars.

Confirms it's a commercial venue event organized by Hemingway's Cuba with a complimentary lesson from Duarte Latin Dance followed by a DJ set; no mention of membership or an established regular community.

Search results describe Miami Nights as a weekly Saturday night at a hotel rooftop bar with drink specials and bar bites, framed as a nightlife/date-night destination, not a dance club or association.
The lesson instructor, DuARTE Latin Dance Company, is a separate performing/teaching outfit that appears at Miami Nights as a hired act, not the organizer of a standing 'Miami Nights' community.

Asheville's actual salsa community hub is a distinct Facebook group ('Salsa Dance in Asheville NC') covering multiple venues; Miami Nights has no dedicated Facebook group, page, or sign-up of its own that turned up in search.
